preview_limitations.detail: The discarded size/resize discrepancy is repaired: original and current native public APIs report size zero after discard and restore a 100-byte firm allocation into the same handle while leaving another handle discarded. See evidence/canonical/allocator-fixtures/. Full native/DOS heap-history equivalence remains unproved: discarded name/age/attributes retain per-slot metadata instead of the shared DOS template; paragraph copying, flags/counters, 16-bit limits, physical/EMS layout and failure policy remain outside this bounded repair. Canonical algorithms are unchanged.

FindIndex native one-past guard returns null before canonical index[count] predicate. Real song lookup10010 can miss past HCEGANT271 rows before SOUND succeeds. Original SOUND allocation followed by original Ralloc320 makes a neighboring Block header match synthetic ID0/kind22 and return as an index row; allocation304/free controls and known mono IDs10000/10010 return null. Natural game false-hit reachability and native/DOS heap-history equivalence remain unproved. Native preview semantic exception; bounded observable difference confirmed in evidence/canonical/native-findindex-boundary/.
Font bitmap native group is source-owned1280 bytes; larger output remains unsupported without source storage proof.

Omitted DOS argument slots are native zero normalizations. win_Swap stores four caller stack-residue words in DOS; native stores zero, so raw state differs. Current callsites, 34 shipped window resources and the reviewed source observer closure do not observe those differing fields. Custom resource/caller domains remain unsupported; no mechanical raw-state equivalence claim.

preview_limitations.module: S26/native window object views and allocation
preview_limitations.detail: Valid registry-backed object views preserve the source layout relationship. Invalid NULL views remain faultable because callers dereference the returned pointer. Native OOM guard policy and zoom savedRect behavior remain unresolved outside the reviewed valid shipped-resource domain.

Declared storage/parameter/cast widths and closed explicitly typed unsigned-word additive/comparison expressions are converted mechanically. Declaration-driven intermediate wrap, products/division, shifts, macro expressions and general unsuffixed literal typing still need lowering/domain proof because native integer promotions differ from DOS16bit rules. The bounded closed-expression proof does not establish global expression equivalence. See evidence/canonical/native-word-expressions/ and evidence/canonical/native-integer-promotions/.

Four-word DOS enqueue calls inherit an unprovided fifth Event.v word; native supplies zero. Original-instruction controls prove differing queued v under caller-stack contrast, while explicit fifth-zero controls remain equal. Coordinate observers exist; full interleaving/observer closure remains required. See evidence/canonical/event-omitted-word/.

Native removes physical BIOS one-floppy B-to-A remapping and uses host drive resolution. Current Windows drive tests validate path services, but no DOS/native physical device-domain comparison or complete caller policy has been accepted.

held_input_polling.contract: Refresh the shared SDL input/time owner before scan-state queries so INT09/INT33 transitions remain observable in source held-input busy waits.
held_input_polling.scope: Bounded logo/customer-dialog mouse and key release; no global event-interleaving equivalence claim.

generated_runtime_resources.role: Native filesystem availability probe; real file handles, no original installer contents.
generated_runtime_resources.observed_contract: Five open("install.exe",0) calls, five matching close calls; file bytes are never read or executed.

native_audio_boundary.devices: OPL3 in OPL2 compatibility mode; SB DSP direct unsigned 8-bit DAC
native_audio_boundary.trace: SIMANT_AUDIO_TRACE existing directory; io-sb_dsp/io-opl DOS OUT format
limitations: Generic SB DMA and device IRQs are unimplemented and fail closed; canonical mode 6 uses PIT IRQ0 and direct DAC command 10h.
Host monotonic scheduling is not cycle-accurate DOS CPU execution; trace timing requires explicit comparison tolerance.
Other audio modes are unsupported; source startup time and full timer-chain/menu/save ABI equivalence are not claimed.
native_audio_boundary.source_selection: Canonical CFG selection retained; platform no longer forces /s1. Explicit /s6 or /s0 accepted.
native_audio_boundary.validation_and_limits: Sound Blaster mode 6 uses canonical C and a readable m28BC ISR projection, existing channel owners and source volume-table directives. OPL3/OPL2-compatibility synthesis is ymfm BSD-3-Clause; SB direct U8 DAC/reset/mute and IRQ0 cadence are hosted. A bounded fresh sound-duration window matches all 5 DSP and 13476 OPL port/value writes from the original new-game-save oracle. First-musical-command-relative OPL timing is within 2 ms; absolute startup differs by about one second. Generic SB DMA/device IRQs, other device profiles, complete BIOS INT08 chain phase/reentry, and menu/save option cross-owner ABI views remain unproved/unsupported. Static music/effect reads in m00DF map mechanically to canonical 07AA owner words; no ordinary owner or game branch is introduced.
native_audio_boundary.classification: TRUE_PLATFORM_BOUNDARY; unsupported hardware profiles fail explicitly, no semantic exception or ordinary source modification
